title: Erosion+
description: Shows the erosion enchantment on the sword when you play eggwars.
body:
## What is this?
This resource pack shows the sharpness 5 and erosion 1 enchantments on swords when you play Eggwars. 

![Image shows the textures for sharpness 5 and erosion enchantments.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bbcea4ddf2d0fccfb320a76d490212cf55040822_0.webp)

![Image shows proof of the erosion enchantment.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dbc067300f81185c1e5c5742d7b12b1c787d02d6_0.webp)


## How it works?
### Option 1 – Fabric users
**Requires**: [Cit Resewn Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/cit-resewn)

1. Install CIT Resewn into your mods folder.

2. Place the resource pack into your resourcepacks folder and enable it.

   
### Option 2 – Forge or Vanilla users
**Requires**: [OptiFine](https://optifine.net/downloads)

For some reason Erosion doesn't work with optifine but sharp5 does.

1. Install OptiFine.
   
2. In-game, go to Video Settings → Quality → Enable Custom Items.

4. Place the resource pack into your resourcepacks folder and enable it.


## Reported Bugs
- Might not work on Fabric if you are using OptiFine (haven't tested). You have to use CIT resewn. For the fps I recommend [sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium).
